system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: the multi-engine backend of an LLM performance simulator: profiling, prediction and analytical engines combined by a fused engine

components.name: Profiling Engine
components.role: operator type + shape -> profile on GPU -> profiling database lookup

components.name: Prediction Engine
components.role: profiling database trains a random-forest predictor for unseen shapes

components.name: Analytical Engine
components.role: roofline computation analysis and a cluster-simulator communication analysis (NVLink / IB) giving comm latency and link utilization

components.name: Fused Engine
components.role: per-operator decision: profiling supported? else prediction supported? else analytical

flows.what: fused-engine fallback chain with Y / N branches

content.key_idea: Every operator is simulated by the most accurate engine that supports it, falling back from profiling to prediction to an analytical model.
content.reading_order: Left panel top (profiling) then bottom (prediction), middle panel (analytical), right panel decision chain top-down.

style.stroke: dark ink ~0.65 pt; dotted outlines on the fused engine's decision boxes and the cluster-simulator region
style.font: Calibri Bold, 6-7 pt at print size; a brace for the roofline min()
style.arrows: short thick black arrows with verb labels (Profile, Lookup, Store Results, Train); Y / N on decision branches
style.icons: GPU-card stacks, database cylinders, a tree glyph for the random forest, switch glyphs

encoding.color_means: panel tint = engine identity; the fused engine's decision boxes repeat the tint of the engine they ask about
encoding.line_style_means: dotted = a reference to another engine / a simulated region
encoding.emphasis: none beyond panel tint and bold titles
reusable_patterns: identity-tinted full panels with white boxes inside
fallback chain whose decision boxes reuse the tints of the panels they refer to
weaknesses: the blue / peach split of the left panel is only a change of tint, no border

evidence: integrates profiling-based, prediction-based, and analytical-based backend engines
a fused backend engine that can use multiple different backend engines

summary: Three tinted panels: the left holds the profiling engine (blue: profile operators on GPUs into a database, look results up) over the prediction engine (peach: train a random-forest predictor from the database); the middle is the analytical engine (mint: roofline for computation, a cluster simulator over NVLink and IB for communication); the right is the fused engine (grey), a Y/N fallback chain from profiling to prediction to analytical.
summary_zh: 后端图：三个整块着色的面板，左边上蓝下桃是实测引擎和预测引擎，中间薄荷色是解析引擎，右边灰色是融合引擎；融合引擎里的判断框沿用前面三种颜色，按 Y/N 逐级回退。
notes: Style reference for the named style 'charon'.
